name: Baseline, ADRs and change control

name: Version and dependency bill of materials

name: Provider capability evidence register
acceptance: Every externally exposed capability has version, permission, eligibility, source date and contract-test evidence.

name: Threat model and abuse cases

name: Data classification and residency matrix

name: Release decision and exceptions process

name: Capacity and cost approval
acceptance: Workbook assumptions are replaced by measured workload distributions and vendor quotas before scale claims.

name: Organization, workspace and environment model

name: Identity, login and MFA

name: Role and attribute authorization

name: Cell directory and signed placement

name: Tenant provisioning saga

name: Configuration snapshot distribution

name: Feature entitlements and quotas

name: Secrets and credential references

name: Agency delegation isolation

name: Offboarding and tenant suspension

name: Tenant migration fencing

name: Developer sandbox isolation

name: PostgreSQL schema and migrations

name: DynamoDB command journal

name: Durable outbox recovery

name: Message timeline projection

name: Message status evidence store

name: Customer and consent records

name: Object storage and media metadata

name: Search indexes and rebuilds

name: Analytics warehouse and lake

name: Retention, backup and erasure

name: Cell-local Kafka deployment

name: Schema registry and event contracts

name: Multi-entry webhook splitting

name: Normalization and deterministic IDs

name: Idempotent projections and offsets

name: Retry and dead-letter handling

name: Replay control and safety

name: Quota-aware ingress protection
